# Workzy Platform

> Workzy is a digital on-demand platform connecting customers with verified skilled service workers for home and commercial maintenance, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, and cleaning tasks.

## Platform Capabilities
- [Service Catalog](https://workzynow.in/services): Browse available professional services and service categories.
- [Worker Registration](https://workzynow.in/join): Onboarding portal for skilled trade professionals.
- [Customer Support](https://workzynow.in/support): Support, dispute assistance, and platform policies.
